buildings.effect_summary: Settlement control + hero services root (analogue of human.keep). Pre-built seed. Binds to largest Water City/Viking house (BP_Big_house_05 candidate).
Siege defense. Timber palisade (lower integrity than stone, higher than orc scar-walls; DESIGN mid-point). Level 2 adds towers (BP_WoodTower / BP_Watchtower).
Resource exchange (analogue of human.market). Level 2 income branch mirrors human.market L2 +gold/day.
buildings.manifestation_ref: VikingVillage BP_StorageMarket variants / BP_HouseBuilding_001 (market-oriented per environment_asset_bindings.json)

buildings.effect_summary: Trade + coastal movement. Signature Viking building. Coastal-movement effect is a DESIGN PROPOSAL (no overmap naval movement in current snapshot; effect would fold into Lane 6 / strategic movement). Dressed with owned Viking boats.

Core fighter dwelling. Gates viking_axe_warrior via RequiredBuildingId. Viking identity: strong early infantry at normal (1-day) tempo, like Orcs but higher per-unit quality. Level 2 adds growth. Bound to the strongest-military authored house (BP_HouseBuilding_003 per environment_asset_bindings.json).
Ranged/skirmisher dwelling (analogue of human.archery_range). Strongest asset-grounding among proposed ranged nodes: explicit owned archery-target props (BP_StrawArcheryTarget_01a/01b).
Shield-guard dwelling (maps to the proven shield-guard role in current combat baseline). Shieldmaiden candidate.

Magic/support dwelling. Viking signature school proposal = Water/Storm (DESIGN; aligns with maritime theme and reuses the Water school already present in HeartlandDevelopment.json spells, Magic.Spell.Water.TidalWard). Binds a viking hero spell via RequiredBuilding.
Shock infantry + morale building. Mead-hall social node doubles as an offense buff source (DESIGN).
Elite heavy fighter capstone. Requires shield branch + shipyard (a wealthy, established harbour). Capstone 3-day timing.
Apex/beast dwelling (COMPOSITE; open yard, not a house). Wolf is a more modest apex than dragon/elephant and may be the most achievable apex across the three factions, but still a LOCAL CHECK.

faction_identity_vs_human: Viking = coastal, tempo-plus-quality. Shares the proven Water magic school and shield-guard role with Humans but reaches them through a harbour economy (shipyard gates the elite capstone). Core infantry at normal (1-day) tempo like Orcs, but higher quality and a mandatory maritime economy node differentiating it from both Human (stone/arcane) and Orc (scavenged/fast).
